noisy.py

− Σ_ℓ PTDF·μ_ℓ − ν·1_max + ξ·1_min
− Σ_gc (e_g·w_t)·μ_co2 = 0

σ_post ≤ thr AND
gain ≥ min_gain

ci_low · ci_high · identifiable : bool · reason

posterior_identifiability, fuel_prices,
co2_price, heat_rates, emission_factors,
variable_oms, z_threshold, absolute_threshold)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 51, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
compute_reference_cost (reference_costs.py)
c_ref = fuel · HR + co2·e · HR + vom
(NREL ATB 2024 / IEA WEO 2024 defaults;
Birge-Hortaçsu-Pavlin 2017 §5)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 51, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
per-gen flag:
standardised z = (c_rec − c_ref)/σ_post
z > +z_thr → withholding
z < −z_thr → distressed
|z| ≤ z_thr → normal
identifiable=False → unidentifiable

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
flags : dict[str, WithholdingFlag]
fields per gen:
recovered · reference · deviation
deviation_sigma · flag : str · reason : str

div.style: color: rgb(26, 0, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HAND-OFF
θ̂ + Σ_post + identifiability + withholding flags
→ feed into the caller's own forward DCOPF /
trading / asset-valuation pipeline.
Forecasting and Monte-Carlo what-ifs are
deliberately out of scope — companies have
their own forecasting stacks; this package
just gives them calibrated bids.
